description: This is a C# source file defining a StatsController class for an ASP.NET Core web API, which provides an endpoint to retrieve grain statistics from an Orleans cluster, along with a SiloData record for representing silo information.

classes.name: StatsController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core controller that provides an API endpoint to get grain statistics from an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Asynchronous method that retrieves detailed grain statistics from the Orleans cluster, processes the data, and returns it as an HTTP response.
